articles.summary: NewGen now has 10,073,535 shares outstanding after issuing stock for a 10% K25.ai stake. The company says market value reached $7.6M on June 18.
articles.title: NewGen Issues 3,666,667 New Shares in Connection with Strategic K25.ai Acquisition, Reaches Milestone of US$7.6 Million Market Capitalization

articles.summary: NewGen lifts its K25.ai stake to $6M at $100M valuation and adds K25.ai founders to the board, launching digital asset treasury with Bitcoin and Solana.
articles.title: K25.ai Secures US$6 Million Strategic Investment from Nasdaq-Listed NewGen at US$100 Million Valuation; Co-Founders to Join Board and Lead Digital Asset Treasury Strategy

articles.summary: Repurchase deal cancels an investor’s notes and warrants, removing potential equity dilution and simplifying NewGenIVF’s capital structure through 2027.
articles.title: NewGen Eliminates Convertible Note and Warrant Overhang with a Significant Investor, Enters Into Settlement Agreement Strengthening Capital Structure

articles.summary: K25.ai completed its US$10M Pre-A round and began Series A fundraising for product launch, licensing and expansion across selected Asian markets.
articles.title: NewGen Increases K25.ai Ownership to 10% in Closed Pre-A Round at US$100 Million Valuation with Total US$10 Million Invested

articles.summary: Stake in K25.ai now worth $6M as NewGen adopts a Bitcoin and Solana digital asset treasury and plans to add K25.ai founder Andy Cheung to the board.
articles.title: NewGen Doubles Down on K25.ai with Additional US$4 Million Stake and Adopts Digital Asset Treasury Strategy
